answer: Autonomous agents deter Sybil attacks using optical line-of-sight telemetry during each transit voyage. A candidate node emits collimated pulses filtered through a saffron absorption cell toward a receiver array atop a knoll. Adversaries cannot simulate nodes virtually because generating the coherent spatial wavefront demands discrete laser emitters and directional gimbals per identity. However, heavy fog attenuates the optical beam, occasionally causing legitimate agents to fail verification.
